title: NDA & 10+2 TES Cadet Entry
summary: How to join the armed forces right after 12th through NDA and Technical Entry Scheme.
author: Sarkari Aavedan Editorial Team
content:
## Introduction

The NDA & 10+2 TES Cadet Entry offers candidates an incredible opportunity for a secure and prestigious career. It requires candidates to clear a multi-tier selection process that rigorously tests their aptitude, physical fitness, and overall capability. Thousands of aspirants apply every year, making it one of the most competitive career paths available today. Strategic preparation based on the latest examination syllabus is vital to stand out and succeed.

## Eligibility Criteria

| Parameter | Requirements |
|---|---|
| **Educational Qualification** | Must have passed 12th standard with Physics, Chemistry, and Mathematics from a recognized state or central board. |
| **Nationality** | Must be a citizen of India, a subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or a person of Indian origin who has migrated with the intention of permanently settling. |
| **Stream/Subject** | PCM (Physics, Chemistry, Maths) is typically strictly required. |
| **Minimum Percentage** | Typically 60% aggregate score is required in PCM. |
| **Document Verification** | Valid ID proof, educational certificates, domicile, and category certificates must be produced in original at the final stages. |
| **Additional Diplomas** | N/A |
| **Computer Literacy** | Basic knowledge of computer operations is often expected and sometimes certified. |

## Age Limit & Relaxation

| Category | Base Age Limit | Age Relaxation Years |
|---|---|---|
| **General (UR)** | 16.5 - 19.5 Years | None (0 Years) |
| **Other Backward Classes (OBC)** | 16.5 - 19.5 Years | None |
| **Scheduled Castes (SC)** | 16.5 - 19.5 Years | None |
| **Scheduled Tribes (ST)** | 16.5 - 19.5 Years | None |
| **Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD)** | N/A | N/A |
| **Ex-Servicemen (ESM)** | N/A | N/A |
| **Departmental Candidates** | N/A | N/A |

## Physical Standards & Test

| Parameter | Male Standard | Female Standard |
|---|---|---|
| **Minimum Height** | 157 cm - 170 cm (Varies widely by region and post) | 152 cm - 157 cm (Varies widely by region and post) |
| **Chest (Unexpanded)** | Minimum 77 cm to 80 cm | Not Applicable |
| **Chest Expansion** | Minimum 5 cm expansion required | Not Applicable |
| **Weight** | Proportionate to height and age as per medical standards | Proportionate to height and age as per medical standards |
| **Running (Sprint)** | 2.4 km run in 15 minutes | 800 meters run in 4 to 5 minutes |
| **Long Jump** | 11 to 14 feet in up to 3 chances | 9 to 10 feet in up to 3 chances |
| **High Jump** | 3.5 to 4 feet in up to 3 chances | 3 feet in up to 3 chances |
| **Vision / Eye Sight** | Minimum 6/6 or 6/9 without glasses, no color blindness | Minimum 6/6 or 6/9 without glasses, no color blindness |

## Written Exam Pattern

| Subject / Section | Total Questions | Maximum Marks | Duration / Time Allowed | Negative Marking |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Mathematics** | 120 Questions | 300 Marks | 2.5 Hours | 0.83 per incorrect answer |
| **General Ability Test** | 150 Questions | 600 Marks | 2.5 Hours | 1.33 per incorrect answer |
| **Overall Grand Total** | **270 Questions**| **900 Marks**| **5 Hours** | **Applicable uniformly** |

## Preparation Strategy Overview

| Preparation Phase | Recommended Action Plan for Candidates |
|---|---|
| **Phase 1: Foundation Building** | Understand the complete syllabus thoroughly. Collect standard reference books, study materials, and begin clearing fundamental concepts across all subjects. |
| **Phase 2: Intensive Practice** | Solve previous year question papers. Enroll in structured mock test series. Analyze performance metrics, identify weak areas, and allocate extra time to improve them. |
| **Phase 3: Final Revision** | Create short, crisp notes for quick recall. Focus on current affairs of the last six months. Avoid picking up completely new topics just before the exam. |
| **Phase 4: Physical & Mental Health**| Maintain a balanced diet, ensure adequate sleep, and incorporate daily physical exercises to clear medical and physical efficiency tests effortlessly. |

We emphasize to all candidates that the details provided above are intended to give you a clear, structured overview of the recruitment framework. Please note that specific numbers, dates, and requirements are subject to modifications as determined by the official recruiting authority. It is highly advised to continually reference the official notification for the most accurate, binding, and up-to-date parameters. Candidates should align their preparation strategies rigorously with the official guidelines to ensure maximum compliance and readiness for all stages.
